title: docs(research): complete the PR2101 Linux replay evidence
body:
## Summary

Complete the executable Linux/WSL2 audit left pending for Adam Gall's PR #2101, exact head `a247ef876e50bf3a7d890c7c1f9b409576674d7d`.

```text
research/selected-final-closure-linux-audit/
  README.md, TASK.json, SOURCES.json   scope, reproduction and exact pins
  EXECUTION.json, *-stdout.txt        commands, environment and execution evidence
  COMPARISON.json, OUTPUTS.json       every output comparison and raw hash
  OUTPUT-DELTA.tar.gz                 six actual changed outputs, 26 KB
  REPLAY-RESULT.json                  complete unchanged control receipt
```

No caller, comparator, frozen source, shared review disposition or selected record changes. Credit Adam Gall, commdata2338, Josie Elliston, Maxime Fleury, Antoine Olivier and the retained supplier/compiler lineage in the README. Coordination: [Discussion1472](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1472#discussioncomment-18972126).

## Evidence

- Before: the [dated review](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/main/research/community-efficient1100-audit/README.md#remaining-review) completed the supplier stage but exceeded its batch budget before finishing PR2101's composed comparison and controls.
- After: CPython 3.12.15 on Linux x86_64 under WSL2 completed both an isolated direct run and the registered replay, in 430.221 and 421.852 seconds. Each checked all 105 outputs, the coupled 13-line outer log, five positive controls and 287 rejection controls. The complete deterministic receipt is byte-identical to the predecessor.
- Actual output has 99 raw-byte matches and six differences, including the invoice and both authenticated raw-hash references. Under the unchanged declared policy the full report has 103 `bytes` classifications and two declared-timing differences. The README distinguishes normalized classifications from raw-byte equality.
- The six-file delta reconstructs the entire first output tree from the pinned reviewed archive. A separate round-trip check matched all 105 sizes/hashes, the complete comparison report and the outer log.
- All 144 `test_research_*.py` workflow tests and the selected baseline binding check passed. Source-pin validation passed before execution. Before submission all 42 scientific input hashes still matched canonical main `f0cf35964766b21a67c5e3b52e4a7daa4ca92a13`, priority revision 5. Fresh overlap covered 489 open PRs and 1,605 discussion/comment/reply records.

The README gives a copyable exact-head worktree/export/replay recipe. This evidence-only package intentionally adds no new verifier or registered hook. The 287 controls were independently executed, not independently reimplemented.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way. Only a scoped evidence package is added.

**Blast Radius:** documentation.

This is not `make frontier1094-verify`, supplier admission or a new kappa. Ancestors were reused from authenticated archives, not rebuilt. Maintainer source/policy review, full cold ancestry and inherited all-size, physical, hosting, precision/tape and analytic obligations remain. No hosted-CI result is claimed.
